theorem mvcc.dget_bktOf (D : backend.Data) (n k : GoString) : backend.dget D n k = backend.bktOf D n
    !! k

def mvcc.window (es : List backend.Ent) (klo khi : GoString) : List backend.Ent :=
  List.takeWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst khi))
    (List.dropWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst klo)) es)

def mvcc.bridgeParams (P : backend.BParams) : Prop :=
  P.has mvcc.keyBI ∧
    P.has mvcc.metaBI ∧
      (∀ (n : GoString), P.HB n = decide (n ≠ go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName)) ∧
        (∀ (n : GoString), P.SB n = decide (n = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName)) ∧
          P.RB go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName = false ∧
            P.RB go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName = false

    γ) Del true rt m L) -∗ Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType go!"ReadTx" (intoVal b)))
    (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName) + (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks (W64 1)).length < 2
    ^ 62) : mvcc.keySafe rv

theorem mvcc.cursorRange_window (es : List backend.Ent) (klo khi : GoString) (lim : w64) (hne : khi
    ≠ []) : backend.cursorRange es klo khi lim = List.take (if sint.Z lim ≤ 0 then 2 ^ 63 - 1 else
    (sint.Z lim).toNat) (mvcc.window es klo khi)

theorem mvcc.kvsOutRd_pairVals (rtx : Loc) (keys vals : GoSlice) (res : List backend.Ent) :
    backend.kvsOutRd rtx keys vals res ⊢ |==> mvcc.pairVals (backend.rdB rtx) keys vals res

theorem mvcc.kvsOutRd_keyVals (rtx : Loc) (keys vals : GoSlice) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (k : GoString) :
    backend.kvsOutRd rtx keys vals (match m !! k with | some v => [(k, v)] | none => []) ⊢ |==>
    mvcc.keyVals (backend.rdB rtx) keys vals m k

    khi).Sublist es

    backend.fkVals <[mvcc.metaBI.name := <[k := v]>(backend.bktOf S mvcc.metaBI.name)]>S =

theorem mvcc.dlR_key {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (X : backend.VData) (k :
    GoString) : backend.dlR P X !! (mvcc.keyName, k) = X !! (mvcc.keyName, k)

theorem mvcc.keyView_relog {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) {st : backend.BSess} {l
    : mvcc.Puts} {vd : backend.VData} {m : mvcc.Bucket} (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (hs :

theorem mvcc.sData_puts {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) {st : backend.BSess} {l :
    mvcc.Puts} {m : mvcc.Bucket} (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (hs : mvcc.sessPuts P st l) (hv :
    mvcc.keyView (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) m) : mvcc.keyView (backend.sData P st.S) (List.foldl
    (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l)

def mvcc.sessPuts (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (l : mvcc.Puts) : Prop :=
  st.ndel = W64 0 ∧
    sint.Z st.pend < sint.Z P.limit + ↑(List.length l) ∧
      backend.bkOf st.W.bks (W64 1) = l ∧ List.length l ≤ 2 ^ 56 ∧ st.cnt.hw = false

theorem mvcc.batchLocked_bkMW [schema_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (γ
    : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st : backend.BSess) (w : backend.FkVals) (X :
    backend.VData) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ w X ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗
    mvcc.bkMW γ w X ∗ ⌜w = backend.fkVals st.S ∧ X = backend.dlR P st.dl⌝

def mvcc.bkLockedC (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b tx : Loc) (m' : mvcc.Bucket) (n :
    Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st,
      backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗
        backend.wbTok γ ∗
          backend.thinV γ (backend.sData P st.S) (backend.vData P (st.C, st.R)) ∗
            ⌜st.tx = tx ∧
                st.cnt.hw = false ∧
                  sint.Z st.pend + ↑n + ↑P.hookMax < 2 ^ 58 ∧
                    (∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = []) ∧
                      mvcc.keysKept m' st⌝)

    ∗ (typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) bk DFrac.discard ∨

    (mvcc.bkLockedO γ P b (n + 1) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods

    (intoVal t))) (intoVal bk)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.bkLockedO (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st,
      backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗
        backend.wbTok γ ∗
          ⌜st.ndel = W64 0 ∧ sint.Z st.pend < sint.Z P.limit + ↑n ∧ backend.viewSame P st ∧ n ≤ 2 ∧ st.cnt.hw = false⌝)

theorem mvcc.bucketIs_isBucket [schema_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions]
    (hID : schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName : schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe :
    schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) (b : GoInterface) (id : w64) (name : GoString) (safe :
    Bool) : isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.bucketIs b id name safe ⊢ backend.isBucket b { id :=
    id, name := name, safe := safe }

theorem mvcc.bktOf_of_sData {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) {S : backend.Data} {m :
    mvcc.Bucket} (h : mvcc.keyView (backend.sData P S) m) (k : GoString) : backend.bktOf S
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName !! k = m !! k

def mvcc.keySized (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ rtx rv,
        backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx rv -∗
          backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx rv ∗
            ⌜GMap.size (backend.bktOf rv.fst go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName) +
                  (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks (W64 1)).length <
                2 ^ 62⌝)

theorem mvcc.mem_dropWhile_sorted {es : List backend.Ent} (hs : backend.entsSorted es) (klo :
    GoString) (e : backend.Ent) : e ∈ List.dropWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst klo)) es
    ↔ e ∈ es ∧ ¬backend.strLt e.fst klo

theorem mvcc.sData_del_HB {P : backend.BParams} {S : backend.Data} {n k : GoString} (h : P.HB n =
    true) : backend.sData P <[n := GMap.delete k (backend.bktOf S n)]>S = backend.sData P S

theorem mvcc.fkVals_delKey (S : backend.Data) (k : GoString) : backend.fkVals <[mvcc.keyBI.name :=
    GMap.delete k (backend.bktOf S mvcc.keyBI.name)]>S = backend.fkVals S

theorem mvcc.crtSnap_wf [schema_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (γ :
    backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b crt rtx : Loc) (rv : backend.RView) : backend.crtSnap γ
    P b crt rtx rv ⊢ backend.crtSnap γ P b crt rtx rv ∗ ⌜rv.snd.Wf⌝

theorem mvcc.bt_leaseDel [schema_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (hDel :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeDelete.spec) (hUL : backend.batchTxBuffered.Unlock.spec) (hID :
    schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName : schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe :
    schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (γ :
    backend.BNames) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b t : Loc) : isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗ isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗ backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ typedPointsto
    (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ⊢ □ ∀ l bk key k dq r, □ ∀ Φ, typedPointsto
    (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Lease) bk DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.bkLocked γ P
    b l ∗ ownSlice key k dq ∗ backend.rbPart γ (fun x => x = mvcc.leaseName) r ∗ ⌜mvcc.leaseParams
    P⌝ -∗ ▷ ((∃ U, U ∗ mvcc.unlockAt { ty :=
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType, v := intoVal t }
    (mvcc.bkView γ) W Pk U l) ∗ ownSlice key k dq ∗ backend.rbPart γ (fun x => x = mvcc.leaseName)
    (mvcc.rbDel r mvcc.leaseName k) ∗ ⌜mvcc.leaseParams P⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal
    (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
    go!"UnsafeDelete" (intoVal t))) (intoVal bk)) (intoVal key)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.rtTok (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b rtx : Loc) (rv : backend.RView) (qo :
    Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx rv ∗ backend.bOpen γ qo)

    true) : backend.rbData P <[n := GMap.delete k (backend.bktOf S n)]>S = mvcc.rbDel
    (backend.rbData P S) n k

    khi lim).Sublist (mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi)

    mvcc.keyBI.name k = false

def mvcc.metaBI : backend.BucketInfo :=
  { id := W64 2, name := go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName, safe := false }

def mvcc.bkRT (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (qo : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.rdTok γ P b ∗ backend.bOpen γ qo)

    : GoSlice) (khi : GoString) (dq : DFrac) (hne : khi ≠ []) : ownSlice hi khi dq ⊢ ⌜hi = slice.nil
    ↔ khi = []⌝

    (mvcc.keySized γ P b)

def mvcc.crtTok (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b crt rtx : Loc) (rv : backend.RView)
    (qo : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.crtSnap γ P b crt rtx rv ∗ (backend.crTok γ b -∗ backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗ backend.bOpen γ qo)

theorem mvcc.sData_delKey_lookup {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (S : backend.Data)
    (k : GoString) (nk : GoString × GoString) : backend.sData P <[mvcc.keyName := GMap.delete k
    (backend.bktOf S mvcc.keyName)]>S !! nk = if nk = (mvcc.keyName, k) then none else backend.sData
    P S !! nk

    (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (hs : mvcc.sessPuts P st []) : backend.viewSame P st

    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeRange.spec) (hDel : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeDelete.spec)
    (hUP : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafePut.spec) (hUL : backend.batchTxBuffered.Unlock.spec) (hID
    : schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName : schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe :
    schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (hHK : ∀
    (k : GoString), mvcc.metaCompactKey k → P.HK go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName k
    = false) (hFV : ∀ (v : GoString), mvcc.metaRevVal v → P.FV v) (γ : backend.BNames) (W Pk : IProp
    GF) (b t : Loc) : isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗ isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗ backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ typedPointsto
    (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ⊢ □ ∀ q m bk lo hi klo khi limit dqlo dqhi w0 X0, ⌜0
    < sint.Z limit ∧ sint.Z limit ≤ mvcc.rangeLimitMax ∧ khi ≠ []⌝ → □ ∀ Φ, typedPointsto
    (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) bk DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.bkLocked γ P b
    [] ∗ mvcc.bkView γ q m ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ w0 X0 -∗ (▷ ∀
    ks vs, (mvcc.bkView γ q m ∗ ownSlice lo klo dqlo ∗ ownSlice hi khi dqhi ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ w0 X0 ∗ ∃
    m' Rd U, U ((sint.Z limit).toNat + 1) ∗ mvcc.snapThin m m' (mvcc.bkDel γ) ∗ ⌜∀ (k : GoString),
    mvcc.snap.physLookup m X0 k ≠ none → (m' !! k).isSome = true⌝ ∗ (□ ∀ n, mvcc.rdCap Rd (U n)) ∗
    (□ ∀ n, mvcc.rdCap2 Rd (U n)) ∗ mvcc.pairVals Rd ks vs (List.take (sint.Z limit).toNat
    (mvcc.bucketRange m' klo khi)) ∗ (□ ∀ key k n w X, □ ∀ Φ, typedPointsto (globalAddr
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) bk DFrac.discard ∗ U (n + 1) ∗ mvcc.bkDel γ k ∗ □
    Rd key k ∗ ⌜(m' !! k).isSome = true⌝ ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ w X -∗ ▷ ((U n ∗ ∃ X', mvcc.bkMW γ w X' ∗
    ⌜mvcc.dlStep X X' k⌝) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (methods
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType go!"UnsafeDelete"
    (intoVal t))) (intoVal bk)) (intoVal key)) {{ Φ }}) ∗ (□ ∀ n w X, mvcc.metaPutCap { ty :=
                                                            go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType,
                                                          v := intoVal t }
                                                        iprop(U (n + 1) ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ w X) fun k v =>
                                                        iprop(U n ∗ mvcc.bkMW γ (mvcc.fkPutV w k v) X)) ∗
                                                  □
                                                    ∀ n,
                                                      □
                                                        ∀ Φ,
                                                          U n ∗ W ∗ Pk -∗
                                                            ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                                                              WP
                                                                ((intoVal
                                                                    (methods
                                                                      go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                                                                      go!"Unlock"
                                                                      (intoVal t)))
                                                                  (intoVal ()))
                                                                {{ Φ }}) -∗
                        Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
                  WP
                    (((((intoVal
                              (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType
                                go!"UnsafeRange" (intoVal t)))
                            (intoVal bk))
                          (intoVal lo))
                        (intoVal hi))
                      (intoVal limit))
                    {{ Φ }}

theorem mvcc.windows_range (Cs Rs : List backend.Ent) (C : backend.BktData) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (klo
    khi : GoString) (hCs : ∀ (e : backend.Ent), e ∈ Cs ↔ C !! e.fst = some e.snd) (hCsort :
    backend.entsSorted Cs) (hRsort : backend.entsSorted Rs) (hm : ∀ (k : GoString), m !! k =
    (backend.lastVal Rs k).or (C !! k)) (hsafe : ∀ (kc vc : GoString) (e : backend.Ent), C !! kc =
    some vc → e ∈ Rs → backend.strLt kc e.fst) : mvcc.window Cs klo khi ++ mvcc.window Rs klo khi =
    mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi

    ∧ sint.Z (st.pend + W64 1) + ↑P.hookMax < 2 ^ 58

    : backend.VData} {m m' : mvcc.Bucket} (hvd : mvcc.keyView vd m) (hS : mvcc.keyView

def mvcc.keySafe (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  (∀ (kc vc : GoString) (e : backend.Ent),
      backend.bktOf rv.fst go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName !! kc = some vc →
        e ∈ backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks (W64 1) → backend.strLt kc e.fst) ∧
    GMap.size (backend.bktOf rv.fst go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName) +
        (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks (W64 1)).length <
      2 ^ 62

theorem mvcc.storeBackend_of_backendC [schema_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (hCRT :
    backend.backend.ConcurrentReadTx.spec) (hRT : backend.backend.ReadTx.spec) (hBT :
    backend.backend.BatchTx.spec) (hFC : backend.backend.ForceCommit.spec) (hSz :
    backend.backend.Size.spec) (hSzU : backend.backend.SizeInUse.spec) (hcRL :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.RLock.spec) (hcRU : backend.concurrentReadTx.RUnlock.spec) (hcUR :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hrRL : backend.readTx.RLock.spec) (hrRU :
    backend.readTx.RUnlock.spec) (hrUR : backend.readTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hLI :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockInsideApply.spec) (hLO :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockOutsideApply.spec) (hSP : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeSeqPut.spec)
    (hUL : backend.batchTxBuffered.Unlock.spec) (hbUR : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeRange.spec)
    (hCB : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeCreateBucket.spec) (hDel :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeDelete.spec) (hID : schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName :
    schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe : schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) (hLSR :
    backend.backend.LockForSafeRangeDelete.spec) (hUSR :
    backend.backend.UnlockForSafeRangeDelete.spec) (hUP : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafePut.spec) (d
    : mvcc.KBReal) (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams d.P) (Pk : IProp GF) (γb : GName) (γi : mvcc.IdxNames) :
    isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗ isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗ backend.isBackend d.γB d.P (mvcc.lateW d.gx)
    Pk d.be ∗ mvcc.keySized d.γB d.P d.be ∗ mvcc.storeDlReg d.γB γi ∗ backend.fkV d.γB true ⊢ ∀ s γ,
    ⌜γ.bucket = γb ∧ γ.kb = some d ∧ γ.idx = γi⌝ → mvcc.storeBackend (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType (intoVal d.be)) s γ Pk

    k

    mvcc.Bucket} (hv : mvcc.keyView vd m) (hsub : ∀ (nk : GoString × GoString) (v : GoString),
    backend.vData P rv !! nk = some v → vd !! nk = some v) : mvcc.keyView (backend.vData P rv)
    (GMap.filter (fun k x => (backend.vData P rv !! (mvcc.keyName, k)).isSome) m)

theorem mvcc.rtRange_clean {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) {rv : backend.RView} (hR
    : rv.snd.Wf) (hs : mvcc.keySafe rv) {m : mvcc.Bucket} (hv : mvcc.keyView (backend.vData P rv) m)

    (mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi)

def mvcc.keysKept (m' : mvcc.Bucket) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : GoString),
    (m' !! k).isSome = true →
      (backend.bktOf st.S mvcc.keyName !! k).isSome = true ∨ (st.dl !! (mvcc.keyName, k)).isSome = true

theorem mvcc.zip_pairs (rtx : Loc) (l : List backend.Ent) (ks vs : List GoSlice) : ks.length =
    l.length → vs.length = l.length → (([∗list] x ∈ ks.zip (List.map Prod.fst l), backend.rdB rtx
    x.fst x.snd) ∗ [∗list] x ∈ vs.zip (List.map Prod.snd l), backend.rdB rtx x.fst x.snd) ⊢ [∗list]
    i ↦ p ∈ l, iprop(∃ ksl vsl, ⌜ks[i]? = some ksl ∧ vs[i]? = some vsl⌝ ∗ □ backend.rdB rtx ksl
    p.fst ∗ □ backend.rdB rtx vsl p.snd)

    (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ⊢ □ ∀ l q m bk key val k v, □ ∀ Φ, typedPointsto
    (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Key) bk DFrac.discard ∗ mvcc.bkLocked γ P b
    l ∗ mvcc.bkView γ q m ∗ ownSlice key k DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice val v DFrac.discard ∗
    ⌜mvcc.keyPutOk m l k v⌝ -∗ ▷ (mvcc.bkLocked γ P b (l ++ [(k, v)]) ∗ mvcc.bkView γ q m -∗ Φ
    (intoVal ())) -∗ WP ((((intoVal (methods
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.batchTxBuffered.ty.PointerType go!"UnsafeSeqPut"
    (intoVal t))) (intoVal bk)) (intoVal key)) (intoVal val)) {{ Φ }}

    (intoVal bk)) (intoVal key)) (intoVal endKey)) (intoVal limit)) {{ Φ }}

theorem mvcc.storeDlReg_congr [schema_sem : go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions]
    (γB : backend.BNames) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (Cmp : Prop) : mvcc.storeDlReg γB γ.idx ⊢ (□ ∀ k,
    mvcc.bkDel γB k -∗ ◇ mvcc.delKey γ k) ∗ □ (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗ ∀ k, mvcc.delKey γ k -∗ mvcc.bkDel γB k)

theorem mvcc.mem_window {es : List backend.Ent} (hs : backend.entsSorted es) (klo khi : GoString) (e
    : backend.Ent) : e ∈ mvcc.window es klo khi ↔ e ∈ es ∧ go.GoStringLe klo e.fst ∧ backend.strLt
    e.fst khi

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_of_backend [schema_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (hCRT :
    backend.backend.ConcurrentReadTx.spec) (hRT : backend.backend.ReadTx.spec) (hBT :
    backend.backend.BatchTx.spec) (hFC : backend.backend.ForceCommit.spec) (hSz :
    backend.backend.Size.spec) (hSzU : backend.backend.SizeInUse.spec) (hcRL :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.RLock.spec) (hcRU : backend.concurrentReadTx.RUnlock.spec) (hcUR :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hrRL : backend.readTx.RLock.spec) (hrRU :
    backend.readTx.RUnlock.spec) (hrUR : backend.readTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hLI :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockInsideApply.spec) (hLO :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockOutsideApply.spec) (hSP : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeSeqPut.spec)
    (hUL : backend.batchTxBuffered.Unlock.spec) (hbUR : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeRange.spec)
    (hCB : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeCreateBucket.spec) (hDel :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeDelete.spec) (hID : schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName :
    schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe : schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) {P : backend.BParams}
    (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (γ : backend.BNames) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) (Del : GoString →
    IProp GF) (Cmp : Prop) (hC : ¬Cmp) : isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend
    ∗ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗ backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗
    mvcc.keySized γ P b ∗ backend.dlNoDel γ ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType (intoVal b)) (mvcc.bkView γ)
    (mvcc.bkRTx γ P b) (backend.wbTok γ) (mvcc.bkNoCmpF γ) mvcc.keyPutOk Del W W iprop(True) Cmp Pk
    (mvcc.bkHookIs γ) (mvcc.bkReq γ P b) (fun r => iprop(backend.rbPart γ (fun x => x =
    mvcc.leaseName) r ∗ ⌜mvcc.leaseParams P⌝)) (mvcc.bkBt b) iprop(True) iprop(True) (mvcc.bkMW γ)
    fun dq => backend.plHookAt γ dq func.nil

    rtx rv sync.rfrac.half.half ∗ backend.txLive rtx sync.rfrac.half.half ⊢ backend.rtHeld γ P b rtx
    rv

def mvcc.bkLocked (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (l : mvcc.Puts) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st, mvcc.bkLockedAt γ P b st l)

    backend.BktData) (h : P.HB n = true) : backend.sData P <[n := x]>S = backend.sData P S

theorem mvcc.isKeyBackendG_of_backendC [schema_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Assumptions] (hCRT :
    backend.backend.ConcurrentReadTx.spec) (hRT : backend.backend.ReadTx.spec) (hBT :
    backend.backend.BatchTx.spec) (hFC : backend.backend.ForceCommit.spec) (hSz :
    backend.backend.Size.spec) (hSzU : backend.backend.SizeInUse.spec) (hcRL :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.RLock.spec) (hcRU : backend.concurrentReadTx.RUnlock.spec) (hcUR :
    backend.concurrentReadTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hrRL : backend.readTx.RLock.spec) (hrRU :
    backend.readTx.RUnlock.spec) (hrUR : backend.readTx.UnsafeRange.spec) (hLI :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockInsideApply.spec) (hLO :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.LockOutsideApply.spec) (hSP : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeSeqPut.spec)
    (hUL : backend.batchTxBuffered.Unlock.spec) (hbUR : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeRange.spec)
    (hCB : backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeCreateBucket.spec) (hDel :
    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafeDelete.spec) (hID : schema.bucket.ID.spec) (hName :
    schema.bucket.Name.spec) (hSafe : schema.bucket.IsSafeRangeBucket.spec) (Cmp : Prop) (hLSR : Cmp
    → backend.backend.LockForSafeRangeDelete.spec) (hUSR : Cmp →
    backend.backend.UnlockForSafeRangeDelete.spec) (hUP : Cmp →
    backend.batchTxBuffered.UnsafePut.spec) {P : backend.BParams} (hP : mvcc.bridgeParams P) (hHK :
    Cmp → ∀ (k : GoString), mvcc.metaCompactKey k → P.HK
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.metaName k = false) (hFV : Cmp → ∀ (v : GoString), P.FV
    v ↔ mvcc.metaRevVal v) (γ : backend.BNames) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) : isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend ∗ isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema ∗ backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ mvcc.keySized γ
    P b ∗ □ (⌜Cmp⌝ -∗ backend.fkV γ true) ⊢ mvcc.isKeyBackendG (interface.mkOk
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.backend.ty.PointerType (intoVal b)) (mvcc.bkView γ)
    (mvcc.bkRTx γ P b) (backend.wbTok γ) (mvcc.bkNoCmpF γ) mvcc.keyPutOk (mvcc.bkDel γ) W W
    iprop(True) Cmp Pk (mvcc.bkHookIs γ) (mvcc.bkReq γ P b) (fun r => iprop(backend.rbPart γ (fun x
    => x = mvcc.leaseName) r ∗ ⌜mvcc.leaseParams P⌝)) (mvcc.bkBt b) (backend.srSlot b)
    (backend.srHeld b) (mvcc.bkMW γ) fun dq => backend.plHookAt γ dq func.nil

theorem mvcc.rbData_insert_tracked {P : backend.BParams} {S : backend.Data} {n : GoString} (b :
    backend.BktData) (h : P.RB n = true) : backend.rbData P <[n := b]>S = <[n := b]>(backend.rbData
    P S)

def mvcc.bkLockedD (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (l : mvcc.Puts) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ st0 bi k,
      backend.batchLocked γ P b (st0.del bi k) ∗
        backend.wbTok γ ∗ ⌜mvcc.sessPuts P st0 l ∧ backend.sessWf P st0 ∧ P.HB bi.name = true⌝)

theorem mvcc.sessPuts_room {P : backend.BParams} (hPw : P.Wf) {st : backend.BSess} {l : mvcc.Puts}
    (hs : mvcc.sessPuts P st l) : sint.Z st.pend + ↑P.hookMax < 2 ^ 58

theorem mvcc.foldl_insert_lookup (l : mvcc.Puts) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (k : GoString) : List.foldl (fun
    m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) m l !! k = (backend.lastVal l k).or (m !! k)
